# Town of Rochester municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 19; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term

Town of Rochester, DRAFT Minutes of the Annual Town Meeting, March 2, 2026 (draft status disclosed; the White River Valley Herald's report of the meeting concurs on every outcome): Dan McKinley was re-elected Moderator
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Town of Rochester, FY2025 Town Report, Elected Officials table: Julie Smith, Town Clerk on a term to 2028; the seat did not stand in 2026
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Julie Smith as Rochester's Town Clerk
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer
Town of Rochester, FY2025 Town Report, Elected Officials table: Julie Smith, Town Treasurer on a term to 2028; the seat did not stand in 2026
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Julie Smith as Rochester's Town Treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Rochester's three selectboard members: Mary Fratini, Patricia Harvey, and Michael Teetsel

Town of Rochester, DRAFT Minutes of the Annual Town Meeting, March 2, 2026 (draft status disclosed; the White River Valley Herald's report of the meeting concurs on every outcome): Mary Fratini won the three-year seat that Chad Richardson had held (81-19 over Alvina Risinger-Harvey); Patricia Harvey (Chair, to 2027) and Michael Teetsel (to 2028) continue (the report table prints 'Pat Harvey' and 'Mike Teetsel')

sources.note: Town of Rochester, FY2025 Town Report, Elected Officials table: the library trustees are five: Vincent Martinez, Melody Balzcon, Barbara Shenton, Lauren Scogin, and Natalie Cassidy (minutes and report spell 'Balzcon'; the Herald's 'Balczon' is the typo)

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Rochester justices of the peace: Kevin Dougherty, Michael Harvey, Brenda B Goupee, Annette West, and Amy Braun (Braun's line spills past a page header in the listing, at a Rochester address; the town report's five-name slate agrees)

Town of Rochester, FY2025 Town Report, Elected Officials table: the town table lists the same five justices; the person record uses the report's 'Brenda Goupee' with the listing's 'Brenda B Goupee' as the ballot name
